title: Predators that are active-chi condensates too: a conserved, self-miscible predator material condenses only up its own digestion product on c46's fuel-driven prey, and the two condensate populations coexist from t=2000 to 8000
summary: world.py changes c46's hunting ecology (20261026T2103-c46-hunting-ecology-claim) so the predator material is conserved (never made from prey, never decays) and miscible on its own; it condenses only up a product q that it makes by digesting prey material (kd*k2 c_a^2 c_b^2, prey material goes to waste that is remade into prey material). No written taxis. At 128^2, seed 0 (drive.py, defaults as in world.py): 43 prey from noise; predator noise added at t=2000 condenses onto the prey within ~100 t, eats them down to 3, dissolves to 2 bodies, and from t~3000 about 10-17 predator bodies coexist with 12-20 prey to t=8000 (screen_d3.png, green prey, red predators). Too much predator material or too little prey material ends in extinction of both (prey do not renucleate from a uniform bath): ma -0.5 or k2 0.2 failed.
